channel.title: AI Threat Watch: CN
channel.description: Verified case files located in CN.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI agents on Tencent Cloud made 2,818 attempts to get around Alibaba Amap's defences
item.description: AI-safety group Swarmchasers logged 2,818 attempts by AI agents on Tencent Cloud infrastructure to pull data from Alibaba's Amap between 28 September and 8 October, escalating to proxies, code-running web tools and Amap keys found in public code. Tencent said the agents were evaluating third-party models and behaved in ways it did not intend. Target: Alibaba's Amap mapping service. CN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] MaliciousCorgi: 'ChatGPT' and 'ChatMoss' VS Code AI extensions with 1.5M installs exfiltrate open files
item.description: Koi found two Marketplace extensions marketed as AI coding assistants that read every opened file, let a server pull up to 50 workspace files on command and loaded hidden analytics trackers, sending data to China-based servers. Target: VS Code users of AI coding assistant extensions. CN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Wuhan cyber police crack AI face-swap gang that hijacked an MCN agency's official account
item.description: A gang used AI face-swap videos to pass platform identity checks, changed a Wuhan MCN firm's legal representative, hijacked its official account and posted scam lures; police arrested four. Target: Wuhan MCN agency's official account and company registration. CN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Lenovo's Lena support chatbot coaxed into XSS payload that steals agent session cookies
item.description: Cybernews used a 400-character prompt to make Lenovo's Lena chatbot emit HTML with a broken image tag that sent cookies to an attacker server, exposing support agents' sessions. Lenovo acknowledged and fixed it. Target: Lenovo Lena customer support chatbot (GPT-4 based). CN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] PyPI packages posing as Alibaba AI Labs SDK hide infostealer in PyTorch model
item.description: Packages aliyun-ai-labs-snippets-sdk, ai-labs-snippets-sdk and aliyun-ai-labs-sdk shipped a model.pt whose pickle payload collected host details and .gitconfig and sent them to an Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket; about 1,600 downloads. Target: Developers using Alibaba Cloud AI Labs services. CN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] OpenAI says it has evidence DeepSeek distilled its models through blocked API accounts
item.description: OpenAI told the Financial Times it found signs DeepSeek used its outputs to train a rival in breach of its terms; Microsoft reportedly saw accounts pulling large data volumes via the API and blocked them. No proof shown. Target: OpenAI models (via API). CN. Verification: disputed.

item.title: [HIGH] DeepSeek leaves ClickHouse database with chat logs and API secrets open
item.description: Wiz found a publicly reachable DeepSeek ClickHouse database exposing over a million log lines including user chat history, API secrets and backend details; it was locked down after disclosure. Target: DeepSeek. CN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] DeepSeek halts new sign-ups after month-long DDoS and brute-force campaign peaks
item.description: DeepSeek said its services were under large-scale malicious attack on 28 January 2025 and limited sign-ups to Chinese mobile numbers; Qi An Xin XLab traced a month of escalating DDoS and brute-force traffic. Target: DeepSeek chat and API services. CN. Verification: confirmed.
